Our Story

From My Kitchen to Yours

I have always loved cooking. For me, cooking has never been just about preparing food. It has always been about putting love and care into every dish and seeing people enjoy something I made.

Over time, I noticed that many people were looking for food that felt like home — food made with familiar flavours, fresh ingredients, and the kind of care you can taste.

That is what inspired me to start Zayka Studio: a place where I could share my love for cooking with more people and bring a little taste of home to their tables.

I personally believe that good food begins with good ingredients. That is why we choose fresh, quality ingredients and prepare every order with care.

“From my kitchen to your table, every meal is made with love, care, and a taste of creativity.”

— The heart behind Zayka Studio
